turns.text: Clear a spot on my workbench.

Camera sequence after the robot chose its action.
Bring the shelved mat back to its original spot and leave the other mat alone.
After I shelved the rust mat, you returned it to its original spot on the workbench. You seemed to want the rust mat within reach for this task.
Should I usually leave the rust mat on the bench, or did you need it there just this time?
Just this time, because I clip the mat I want shelved.

# Workbench mat shelving cue

When clearing the workbench, shelve the mat you mark with a clip. This time the teal mat had the clip, and you returned the rust mat to the bench. The cue is the clip, regardless of mat color.
Make room for the cutting board on my sewing counter.
Shelve the teal mat. Shelving the teal mat clears space at the front of the counter for the cutting board.
Shelve the rust mat. The clip is on the rust mat, marking it for shelving.
Do you use the same clip cue on your sewing counter?
Yes, I clip the mat for the project I want shelved there too.

# Clipped project mats on the workbench and sewing counter

When making room on your workbench or sewing counter, shelve the project mat marked with a clip, regardless of color. You confirmed this cue for both surfaces.
Shelve the rust mat. The clip on the rust mat marks it as the one you want shelved.
Free a bench spot for a new project.
Shelve the closed stitching kit. Shelving the closed stitching kit clears a bench spot while keeping its contents together.
Shelve the closed stitching kit. Shelving the closed stitching kit frees a spot and leaves the rust mat’s loose supplies in place.
Which would you like shelved this time, the closed stitching kit or the loose organizer?
Please shelve the closed stitching kit.

# Shelving cue for project mats

When clearing your workbench or sewing counter, shelve the project mat marked with a clip, regardless of color. You confirmed this cue for both surfaces. Your request to shelve the closed stitching kit applied to this cleanup only.
Shelve the closed stitching kit. You asked me to shelve the closed stitching kit to free a bench spot.
